name: easy-postgres
description: Simple abstraction for working with PostgreSQL database

scripts.db:clean: podman stop easy-postgres-test 2>/dev/null || true; podman rm easy-postgres-test 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.db:start: podman run -d --name easy-postgres-test -e POSTGRES_USER=tim -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=testpassword -e POSTGRES_DB=playground -p 5432:5432 --health-cmd 'pg_isready -U tim' --health-interval 2s --health-start-period 10s docker.io/postgres:17
scripts.db:stop: podman stop easy-postgres-test && podman rm easy-postgres-test
scripts.db:wait: until podman healthcheck run easy-postgres-test; do sleep 1; done
scripts.pretest: npm run db:clean && npm run db:start && npm run db:wait
scripts.test: NODE_OPTIONS='--env-file=.env' mocha; EXIT=$?; npm run db:stop; exit $EXIT

author: Tim Cross
